audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was given to Karma at 7/10 while whys[4] on the same row says Jax's all-in beats her re-poke.
audit.why: Packet levelChart gives Jax every row from level 3 onward, the Emerald+ win rate is 45.83%, and the jax__karma mirror already flipped this exact row to Jax. Karma gains nothing at 6 because Mantra needs no skill point and is live from level 1.
audit.corrected: Row 4 -> Jax in both layers as a matched pair, with phases[4].why rewritten to name Grandmaster-at-Arms and state why Karma's 6 is empty.
sources: kit: Karma R 'available at level 1 and does not require a skill point'

audit.whatIsWrong: Jax's ultimate is called 'Grandmaster's Might' in whys[4], spikes[2], mid and late. That is not its name in Riot's current data.
audit.why: Data Dragon names the R Grandmaster-at-Arms (110/100/90s), and it is the level-6 spike this whole stage turns on — bonus armour and magic resist plus magic damage on every third attack. Shipping a wrong ultimate name on the champion's own spike section is exactly the class of error that costs trust.
audit.corrected: Renamed to Grandmaster-at-Arms in whys[4], spikes[2] and the level-6 phase.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Counter Strike as a blanket damage block — 'Nothing here works through Counter Strike', 'hold your damage until it ends' — which tells a spell-caster to stop casting for the whole duration.
audit.why: Riot's text is 'dodge all incoming attacks' — basic attacks. Inner Flame and the Mantra-Q cataclysm still land through it, so the correct play is to stop autoing and keep poking, not to hold everything. Counter Strike is 17/15/13/11/9s at 300 range and Leap Strike is 700, which are the numbers that make the spacing rule concrete. Empower is the auto-reset that opens his burst, so the wind-up is the cue to step back.
audit.corrected: Counter Strike restated as an attack dodge with the 17s rank-1 timer in winCon, the do's, the cooldown block, whys[2] and wants.foe[0]; the Empower wind-up added to the don'ts; Soulflare replaced with Mantra-Q.
sources: kit: Jax E 'dodge all incoming attacks', cd 17/15/13/11/9 range 300
